narrative: The post at the Rose. The bill names a new play, and names no man as the author of it. A penny has been paid. At the door a man moves his lips and does not turn them toward the writer. He has not been handed a paper, and he has not written on the bill. The title is the whole of what the post gives. The door-man is still at his own count.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid his penny and read the title.

entities.name: Philip Henslowe
entities.context: Stood at the door with his lips moving, and did not speak.
